name: AI Chatbot & Prompt Engineering Pack
description: Essential prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & local LLMs including persona setup, code refactoring, bug analysis, and summarization.

snippets.label: AI Persona: Senior Architect
snippets.expansion_text: Act as a senior software engineer and principal architect. Provide concise, clean, production-ready code with minimal fluff.

snippets.label: AI: Explain Code Simply
snippets.expansion_text:
Explain the following code step-by-step in simple terms, highlighting key logic and potential edge cases:

{{clipboard}}

snippets.label: AI: Refactor Code
snippets.expansion_text:
Refactor the following code for improved performance, readability, and modern best practices. Include comments explaining key improvements:

{{clipboard}}

snippets.label: AI: Analyze Bug & Debug Log
snippets.expansion_text:
I encountered this error:
```
{{clipboard}}
```
Please analyze the root cause, explain why it occurred, and provide the exact fixed code block.

snippets.expansion_text:

{{clipboard}}

{{clipboard}}
